Dota_2_Release.description:
### **Dota 2 Archipelago World — v0.1.0-beta.1**

Initial public beta release of the Dota 2 Archipelago world!

**Included**

1. Dota 2 Hero Progression groups
2. Progressive Hero Group Unlocks
3. Primordial Fragment Progression (required AP tracking mcguffin)
4. Hero Victory Checks
5. Item Buy Checks
6. Item Unlocks (in the AP only not actually in the game)
7. Item Unlock Requirements for most Items (in the AP only not actually in the game)
8. Configurable Victory Goals
9. Presistent Client Save Data

**Status**
This is the first beta release. Bugs and balance issues may still be present, most notably with Client Save Data
Dota_2_Release.title: v0.1.0-beta.1

v0.1.0.description:
### **Dota 2 Archipelago World — v0.1.0 Official Release**

**CrownFall Minigames are here!** 

- Each minigame is unlocked through its respective item 
- Minigames contain 3 checks each; Nest of Thorns contains 5
- Castle Carnage is **NOT** included, as the minigame scoring format is different from all other games
- Minigame items will always exist even if Minigame Locations are turned off, 
- Scores will be manually submitted with a new client command, so it's an honor system for submitting minigame locations

- All Heroes option has been removed. Can already do unique hero wins and no need to add 127 more filler items.


**New Client Command for Minigames**

- /minigame {first word of minigame title} {score} 
- Example: /minigame Nest 85000 or /minigame spoon 3,000. Capitalization does not matter for the title; supports commas for the score
- minigame keywords are as follows: **gone, bat, oasis, sand, sleet, dragon, zaug's, spoon, spleen, nest**. This is also listed in setup_en.md
v0.1.0.title: v0.1.0

v0.1.0-beta.2.description:
### Dota 2 Archipelago World — v0.1.0-beta.2

**Major Bug Fixes and Feature Changes**

- Total Wins and Unique Hero Wins no longer reset on a reconnect (I was overriding oops)
- No crashing from too many Progressive Group Unlocks being manually sent or found
- Perseverance buy check fixed

- /heroes now shows {name} - {hero group} - {primary attribute} - {ranged/melee} -{# of legs} - {Carry/Support}
- Total Wins will only increment once per Match ID. A single match can still be submitted multiple times for item checks.
- Multiple Unique Hero Wins can still be added per Match ID if you're playing with a squad, must swap playerID each time and parse
- Deward checks lowered from 1,5,10 to 1,3,7
- Item Locations now use the display names from the game
v0.1.0-beta.2.title: v0.1.0-beta.2
